name: Gilt market
summary: UK inflation rose to 3.6% in October; a December Bank Rate rise stays in play and long gilt yields remain high
state: ONS data on 18 Nov showed UK CPI at 3.6% in October, a one-year high, keeping a second straight Bank Rate rise in play (AP via US News). Gilts rallied after softer services inflation trimmed December hike bets (Fixed Income News, 18 Nov). The 10-year yield has been near 19-year highs above 5.3% (Trading Economics); the monthly move stays inside the 40bp line but long yields remain elevated, so Watch is kept.
for_you: High gilt yields feed into mortgage rates; fixed-rate borrowers are affected when they remortgage.
rubric_hit: Long gilt yields near multi-decade highs = Watch; 10y monthly move < 40bp

sources.title: US News (AP) — UK inflation rises to year high, keeps possibility of second straight rate hike alive
Fixed Income News — Gilts rally as softer UK services inflation trims December hike bets

why: Gilt yields set UK mortgage rates and the government's borrowing costs; the 2022 LDI crisis showed how fast it can break.
drivers: Fiscal credibility, BoE policy, inflation, global bond moves, pension-fund flows.

rubric.alert: BoE intervention, or 10y moved > 75bp in a month.
rubric.watch: 30y gilt at multi-decade highs, or 10y moved 40–75bp in a month, or a weak auction.
rubric.normal: 10y gilt moved < 40bp in a month and auctions orderly.
